    # This is a variation of Kadane's algorithm.
    # The problem is equivalent to finding the maximum subarray sum
    # in an array where all numbers are negated.
    
    # min_so_far tracks the minimum sum found for any subarray so far.
    # min_ending_here tracks the minimum sum of a subarray ending at the current position.
    min_so_far = nums[0]
    min_ending_here = nums[0]
    
    # Iterate through the array starting from the second element.
    for i in range(1, len(nums)):
        num = nums[i]
        # The minimum subarray ending at the current position is either
        # the current number itself or the current number added to the
        # minimum subarray ending at the previous position.
        min_ending_here = min(num, min_ending_here + num)
        
        # Update the overall minimum sum if the new min_ending_here is smaller.
        min_so_far = min(min_so_far, min_ending_here)
        
    return min_so_far
